messages:
Raj (Partnerships): ArborLogic sent their co-mark pack and requested a dark-hero variant where their logo is reversed (white-on-black). Theyre pushing for that for the marketplace hero tile. Assets: https://arborlogic.example.com/assets.zip. Theyd like us to publish with the marketplace listing on 2026-05-12 11:30 PT. Can we review for brand + legal?

Jenn (Design): Quick take  the reversed lockup looks ok at large sizes but their SVG has a non-solid fill (gradient stops) which will render poorly in our hero when we apply shadows. Also the spacing in the marketplace tile is tight. Suggest we request a flattened monochrome vector and a separate PNG for small retina tiles.

Marco (Brand): Brand policy: we allow reversed marks only if contrast >= 4.5:1 and the lockup matches our safe-zone. Also we require partner to use the approved partner badge on marketplace tiles (per co-mark rules). If they want an exception to use a gradient, they'd need a justification and a signed variance. Prefer a monochrome variant to keep consistency.

asset-bot: Automated QC run: arborlogic_reversed.svg  issues detected: viewBox missing, non-solid paint (gradient), WCAG contrast 3.2:1 (fail), measured safe-zone = 28px (required >= 40px). Files located at s3://partners/arborlogic/raw/arborlogic_reversed.svg

Sara (Legal): Checklist: 1) trademark attribution line included in all external-facing collateral, 2) partner must sign new logo usage addendum if we grant reversed-lockup, 3) confirm the partner quote text matches submitted and they approve final copy. I can draft the addendum if Brand allows the reversal. Also need PR contact for embargo.

Tom (Sales): ArborLogic is asking for marketplace tile prioritization (featured slot). Theyve committed to co-mark co-sponsored webinar; PR timing is tight. If we block the reversed logo it delays their approval cycle. Can Brand/Design propose a rapid alternative?

Jenn (Design): Uploaded two options to Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abc/ArborLogic-marketplace?node-id=12%3A34 - Option A: monochrome white lockup + 48px safe-zone; Option B: gradient lockup but with overlay mask to preserve contrast. Option A is fastest to ship.

Marco (Brand): Approve Option A (monochrome) for marketplace tile. Well allow reversed mark in the hero only if partner supplies flattened mono SVG and signs the usage addendum. No gradient exceptions for marketplace tiles.

Raj (Partnerships): Raj to partner: can you supply flattened mono SVG and sign the addendum? Also please confirm PR lead and social handles for the joint announcement. ArborLogic replied: PR lead is megan@arborlogic.com; they can provide mono SVG by EOD tomorrow.

asset-bot: Re-scan after upload: arborlogic_mono.svg  viewBox OK, clearspace PASS (40px), contrast PASS (4.6:1). Path: s3://partners/arborlogic/final/arborlogic_mono.svg

Mike (Ops): Note for release: once final assets are uploaded, we'll push the marketplace tile and invalidate CDN. Staging push scheduled for 2026-05-12 10:45 PT. I can automate invalidation and add a rollback tag.

Sara (Legal): Drafted addendum and sent to partner contact (megan@arborlogic.com). Condition: reversed hero lockup approval expires in 6 months and applies only to the marketplace tile and announcement assets. Partner must not alter mark after approval.

Tom (Sales): Partner signed the addendum and returned mono SVG. Also confirmed webinar co-sponsor and social handles.

Marco (Brand): Final: Mono SVG approved. Jenn, use Option A for the tile and ensure badge placement per co-mark doc. Ill log the variance in Brand Confluence: https://confluence.redwood/integrations/arborlogic-variance.

Jenn (Design): Pushed final tile to s3: s3://partners/arborlogic/published/marketplace_tile_v1.png and updated Figma notes for implementation.

Mike (Ops): Staging push complete, CDN invalidation queued for 2026-05-12 10:50 PT. Will monitor after publish.

Raj (Partnerships): Great work team. Publish scheduled: 2026-05-12 11:30 PT. Closing thread unless any last-minute issues. :rocket:
